senses.gloss: m. (preced.) = h. עָב, thickness, darkness, cloud.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 19:9">Targ. Ex. XIX, 9</cite> (Y. some ed. <he>עִיכָּא</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 30:15">Targ. Job XXX, 15</cite> (ed. Lag. a. oth. <he>עבא</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 44:22">Targ. Is. XLIV, 22</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 59a">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>דאתא בע׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דקטר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) when it (the morning) comes with a heavy cloud, opp. <he>עננא</he>.
<cite ref="Taanit 3b:11">Taan. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ דבתר מיטרא כמיטרא</he> a covered sky after the rain is as beneficial as the rain itself.
<cite ref="Taanit 20b:11">Ib. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>כל יומא דע׳</he> on every cloudy day (when heavy rains were threatening).
<cite ref="Yoma 28b:14">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>יומא דע׳ כוליה שמשא</he> on a cloudy day the sun is felt all over; a. fr.
